body:
Source: the ADLC principle-fidelity audit (delta.md, PR #486), seam 7.

Two independent vacuous/coverage-lag edges in the gate suite. (Criterion 2 —
suppression-marker normalization — was SPLIT OUT into its own ticket because the
originally-specced blanket normalization would degrade rails-guard; see that ticket.)

1. spec-lint passed on a spec with ZERO recognized acceptance criteria (or criteria under
   an unrecognized heading). DONE and merged via PR #494 (spec-lint now fails closed, exit 2).
2. The run-tests plugin segments are hand-enumerated with no completeness guard against
   plugins/. A new plugin (or a new test dir inside one) is silently untested. packages/*
   segments are already auto-derived by packageSegments(); the plugins/* list is not.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOR
- Add a completeness test (scripts/test/run-tests-completeness.test.mjs) asserting every
  plugin test directory on disk (plugins/*/**/test, plugins/*/test) is covered by some
  SEGMENT command in scripts/run-tests.mjs. Copy the bijectivity pattern from
  apps/docs/test/toolkit-packages.test.mjs (ALL_PACKAGES must equal the packages/ listing).
  The test fails when a plugin test dir exists that no segment runs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- spec-lint exits 2 on a spec with zero recognized acceptance criteria. verify: `node --test packages/spec-lint/test/zero-criteria.test.mjs`  (DONE, PR #494)
- A run-tests completeness test fails when a plugin test dir is unlisted in SEGMENTS. verify: `node --test scripts/test/run-tests-completeness.test.mjs`

allow-suppression: none
title: Close vacuous-pass edges: spec-lint zero-criteria (done) + run-tests completeness
